div.head: Ps Cn for 30
div.ab: Uolo ut omnis liberalis homo pro libito suo habeat uenerem siue uiridem in planis suis super sua, sine chacea tamen; et deuitent omnes meam, ubicunque eam habere uoluero.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 625 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: I will that every noble man have at his pleasure venison or vert in his open lands on his own [land], but without chase; and let all keep away from mine, wherever I wish to have it.

note.seg: wie 26q adelsfreundlich, giebt Verf. Cnuts allgemeine Erlaubniss mit dem Rechte, Jaghunde zu halten, dem Adel allein
Favouring the nobility, as in 26 note q, the author gives Cnut's general permission, together with the right to keep hunting dogs, to the nobility alone
Verf. lässt siluis aus, offenbar will er die Jagdbefugniss des Unterthanen auch geographisch beschränken
The author omits siluis; evidently he wants to restrict the subject's hunting right geographically as well
ohne das Recht des Jagens missversteht Coke IV Inst. 320; Verf. meint, wie 21, 2r, ausserhalb des umhegten Jagdreviers; denn sine, wie afrz. sens und mhd. ohne, heisst öfter ausgenommen

Coke IV Inst. 320 misunderstands it as 'without the right of hunting'; the author means, as in 21, 2 note r, 'outside the enclosed hunting ground'; for sine, like Old French sens and Middle High German ohne, often means 'except'
